0022600133.text: The Cavaliers (2-1, with a 2-0 home record and two straight wins) host the Wizards (2-2, coming off a loss) in a matchup where Cleveland sits 2nd in the Central, 0.5 games back, and 6th in the East, while Washington is 3rd in the Southeast, 1 game back, and 9th in the East. Washington will be without Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (out, foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip pinched nerve). The Cavaliers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 130-117 win in Cleveland on April 12, 2026, and the teams have not yet met this season.
